description: This file defines the SearchResponse class, which encapsulates search result data including total count, entry count, search entries, and search facets, used likely as a data transfer object in search functionality.

classes.name: SearchResponse
classes.description: A Java class representing the response from a search query, containing counts, entries, and facets.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of search entries available.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of search entries available.

methods.name: setEntryCount
methods.description: Sets the number of search entries requested.

methods.name: getEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of entries requested.

methods.name: setEntries
methods.description: Sets the list of search entries.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the list of search entries.

methods.name: setFacets
methods.description: Sets the map of search facets categorized by facet key.

methods.name: getFacets
methods.description: Returns the map of search facets.
